description: Switch an ad squad between max bid (LOWEST_COST_WITH_MAX_BID) and target cost (TARGET_COST), with the bid for the new strategy. An ad squad on auto-bid may be switched to one of these (it adds a bid cap). Switching TO auto-bid is not offered because it would remove the bid cap. The bid follows the same limits as snap_set_bid (absolute SNAP_MAX_BID, +50% per step and per 24 hours). Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

bid.description: Account currency: the max bid, or the target cost

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_bid_strategy
